title: Exact-Rational Multimode Gaussian Steering Monogamy, Harmonic Tight-Frame Saturation, and Remote Wigner-Negativity Certificates
abstract: Motivated by Sudip Chakrabarty's exact resolution (arXiv:2611.34874v1, Nov. 2026) of multimode Gaussian steering monogamy and remote Wigner negativity, we construct a fully machine-checked, zero-float algebraic verification suite (GAUSS-STEER-MONO-CERT-1.0) backed by 20 constructive Lean 4.36.0 theorems (0 sorry, 0 Classical.choice, -DwarningAsError=true), an AST-audited pure-Q Python verifier, 16 SHA-256 certificates (C01-C16), and 62 adversarial tests. We prove and certify: (i) exact share-budget pigeonhole ceilings M <= 2k-1 (Gaussian steering) and M <= nk-1 (n-setting arbitrary measurements), plus the strict n >= 3 necessity whenever M > 2k-1; (ii) exact equal-share harmonic tight-frame saturation s_j = k/(2k-1) > 1/2 across k in {1,2,3,4,8} and an explicit exact-Q rank-2 orthogonal projector P = I_3 - J_3/3 realizing k=2, M=3; (iii) the squeezing-invariant symplectic Schur-complement factorization nu_{A|B} - 1 = (a-1)(1-2*eta)/(eta*(a-1)+1), proving steering iff eta > 1/2 for every finite squeezing a > 1 and exact vanishing at eta = 1/2 even at a = 1000; and (iv) exact remote Wigner-origin certificates pi*W_out(0) = 1 - 2*eta*(1-eps) pinning the tight-frame heralding-error tolerance to eps < 1/(2k).
